meta.title: Oceanar · Ocean experiences
meta.description: To ocean is to put ocean culture into action. Sound art, immersive experiences and ocean culture from Puerto Madryn, Patagonia.

hero.tagline: sound art · ocean culture · immersive experiences

action: TO OCEAN is to put ocean culture into action.

sections.intro: We blend art, technology and encounter to create immersive experiences that connect us sensitively with the ocean.

items.name: Field guide to exploring the sea
items.text: A guide by Editorial Albatros for children to discover the sea's environments and living things, with QR codes for ocean sounds and activities. We contributed scientific content and audiovisual material.
items.photoAlt: Cover of the Guía de campo para explorar el mar, by Editorial Albatros

sections.intro: We research and create from our encounter with the sea, exploring it as a living territory of memory, biodiversity and transformation.

items.name: Ojos al mar
items.text: A feature documentary by Primavera Films, opening film of the Patagonia Eco Film Fest 2024. We took part as co-producers and with underwater footage.
items.photoAlt: Poster of the film Ojos al mar: a person swimming at the surface

items.name: Matilde & Armonía
items.text: A children's novel about the friendship between Matilde and Armonía, a young southern right whale. Each chapter has a QR code that leads to a website with activities; we took part in the book's digital support.
items.photoAlt: Cover of the book Una niña... una ballena... un mar
